summary: Accepted all 19 sealed chronology-only operations. The candidate restores Guangqi (AD 885–888), Tianfu (AD 901–904), Tianfu-era Zhang Congxun death (AD 936–942), and Mingzong’s reign (AD 926–933) without changing event owners, wording, evidence, or unrelated chronology.

sourceEvidence: s0200: 「唐光啟中，罕之與河南張全義為仇，交相攻擊，罕之兵敗，北投太原，武皇以澤州處之，罕之將赴任，留頃為質焉。」
reviewedChanges.reason: 光啟 is the Tang era AD 885–888. The sentence dates the related hostaging, feud, and flight events only 中 (during) that era, so the four AD 885 point claims and corresponding active hints must be intervals rather than first-year assignments.

sourceEvidence: s0204: 「天復中，梁祖自鳳翔送唐昭宗歸長安，留軍萬人，命侄友倫與頃總之，以宿衛為名。」
reviewedChanges.reason: 天復 spans AD 901–904. The passage places Liang Zu’s escort, the retained force, and Youlun and Qing’s joint command during that era; it does not select AD 903. The proposal correctly retains the existing AD 904 and AD 907 independent hint events for p093.

sourceEvidence: s0191: 「尋授絳州刺史、檢校太保，在任數年，天福中，卒於官，年五十二。」
reviewedChanges.reason: 天福中 bounds Zhang Congxun’s death in office to Later Jin Tianfu, AD 936–942. Both the attestation and separately classified death dateContext need that same interval; a lower bound at AD 936 loses the explicit reign endpoint and a point year would overstate the source.
明宗朝 identifies Mingzong’s full AD 926–933 reign, not merely its accession year. The appointment and active-date hint therefore correctly change from an AD 926 lower bound/point to that interval.
